summary: Independently reproduced the brace-key bug on upstream 4e5faa3d7e4008d89e0d8bf1ea87b6d9a061a16d and its correction on the exact candidate. The same 76-case checker had 20 failures upstream and none on the candidate, with no oracle errors. Candidate tox -e py312 passed all 686 tests. This confirms the tested formatting behavior on Python 3.12.15, not universal correctness or remote CI.
evidence: Read only claim.md and Python's formatting definition before writing the independent checker; no prior reviewer evidence or verdicts were consulted. Definition: https://docs.python.org/3.12/library/string.html#format-string-syntax. Checker: runs/2026-10-14/reviews/reproduce.py; SHA256 680b758fbeca4901da82d40af0d43090c055c1e620af513cbdc0ee079c9aba1d. Production implementation and author tests were first inspected after both final checker runs.

The checker validates exact inferred strings, output equivalence with str.format, and token field names against string.Formatter.parse. Its 76 valid cases cover anonymous, named and numbered fields; brace and opening-bracket keys; repeated item lookups; item/attribute combinations; conversions; nested width and precision fields; escaped braces; literal brackets; bracket fill characters; and ordinary formats.

The preliminary checker generated five nested-width inputs that str.format itself rejects for unbalanced braces. These inputs were removed before inspecting production code, without changing expectations for any valid case. The preliminary command and output are retained in .work/evidence/2026-10-14/40aba76eda94/result.json and .work/evidence/2026-10-14/40aba76eda94/output.log.

Baseline source was independently cloned from https://github.com/mahmoud/boltons.git into .work/checkouts/mahmoud-boltons-review-baseline, then detached at 4e5faa3d7e4008d89e0d8bf1ea87b6d9a061a16d. The baseline and candidate working trees were clean. The candidate checkout was not edited.

Both final checks ran the exact reproduce.py contents as the python -c argument through python3 night.py run --checkout CHECKOUT --image python:3.12-slim --timeout 60 -- python -c CODE. Both retained command arrays were compared byte-for-byte with the saved checker. Image digest: python@sha256:a6e34c598f2467ed0e9a8d349809fcd8b5c603269512df273a0bb1784edc11b1; runtime Python 3.12.15.
